svg.title: Just Eat Finder — main Branch Architecture

g.text: Just Eat Finder — main Branch Architecture
Dark mode via useColorScheme + isDarkMode prop
Errors are surfaced with native Alert dialogs.
useRestaurantSorting maps the selected option to a
useKeyboardVisible is defined but not currently wired.
- api: postcode validation, restaurant fetch, orchestration
- filtering: cuisine emoji formatting for card display
- sorting: rating / rating-count / name orders (asc & desc)
Components receive isDarkMode and typed props from their
owning page; there are no shared design tokens on main.
API URLs / SortOrder / cuisine emoji map
